calls.statement:
SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS d, status,
  COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS n_distinct
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-30' AND DATE '2025-12-02'
   OR CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
),
t AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_test,
    MIN(CASE WHEN p.category <> 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_test_flag,
    COUNT(f.sales_line_id) AS lines
  FROM o LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
  LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(has_test) AS with_test_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN lines=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE order_total_gross <= 0 OR line_count = 0) AS odd_totals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL) AS no_dispatch,
  (SELECT MIN(order_ts_utc) FROM o) AS mn, (SELECT MAX(order_ts_utc) FROM o) AS mx
FROM t
